parameters.content:
## PILOT v3.1 — Satyer Prohor AI Video Pipeline (motion fix, 2026-10-25)
MOTION RULE (Jony): real video first, never stills-only, never reused old pictures. Each scene searches FRESH Wikimedia video clips (no key needed); Flux stills are fallback with strong Ken Burns motion; Creatomate adds template motion graphics when keyed.
Flow: Gemini topic -> Chat Memory Manager -> Claude 3.5 Sonnet script+scenes -> Muse media & tone planner -> Flux images -> Creatomate motion graphics -> ElevenLabs voice -> manifest -> Facebook (DISABLED)
Keys needed: Gemini, Anthropic (Claude), Flux provider (fal.ai), Creatomate API + template ID, ElevenLabs API + voice ID, Facebook Page token.
Workflow INACTIVE — nothing auto-runs or posts until Jony provides keys and says so.
NOTE: this v3 replaces the v2 writer routing (story->ChatGPT / documentary->Gemini) with one Claude script writer for all content types, per the new list. Say the word to restore routing.

## Chat Memory Manager
Stores past topics, tone notes and run count in /agency/memory.json on the n8n container (bind-mounted agency data layer). Used to avoid repeating topics and to keep tone continuity. Edit tone_notes in that file any time to steer future scripts.

## Creatomate — READ BEFORE FIRST RUN
modifications keys (Title / Images / Captions) are placeholders — they MUST match your Creatomate template's element names. Edit the node after choosing the template. Creatomate renders are async: poll the render status before publishing.
